page_note: This page is entirely pastoral-ecclesial application: it describes the spiritual decline of a community member who refuses rebuke, separates from teacher/brothers, becomes haughty and slack — followed by intervention by the 'teachers of the church' to restore him in the 'building of God.' Cosmological terms (Sin, Mind of Light, enthumesis of death) appear, but they are deployed as moral-psychological forces in a pastoral narrative, not as cosmic mappings. The vehicle is community discipline. No oldest-substrate teaching is recoverable from this page. Editorial fatigue score and second-half ecclesial vocabulary spike confirm this is application material throughout.
